jev_billing.source: User-reported aggregate spend in this conversation; no invoice independently inspected
jev_billing.allocation_method: Reported aggregate spend divided by 2080 terminal requests, multiplied by scenario JEV calls
limitations: Effective average spend per request, not a verified fixed provider tariff
Test allocation assumes the same mean cost as the combined pilot, validation and test requests; per-request token costs may differ
The log also contains 18 nonterminal JEV connection failures; their billing treatment is not separately known
Main figure uses historical LLM USD pricing assumptions; separate bill reconciliation uses llm_billing.json
Applies only to this RAGTruth run, not VitaminC

method: JEV reported aggregate mean times calls, plus recorded LLM tokens at historical USD rates. A pricing scenario, not actual billed savings.
cost_reduction: Positive means lower scenario cost versus the corresponding pure LLM; negative means higher. Low/low and high/high price comparisons; not a confidence interval.
